priest.name: Pandit Pawan Shastri
priest.intro: Pandit Pawan Shastri is a renowned Vedic acharya and tantra practitioner from Ujjain (Avantika Tirth). He holds an M.A. in Vedic Studies and has been devoted to religion, spirituality, and Vedic rituals since childhood. His daily practice includes traditional mantra recitation, shuddhi rituals, and family puja guidance.
priest.training: Pandit Ji received deep and practical knowledge of all types of Vedic rituals, puja procedures and religious samskaras from his father. His family has been performing worship and religious rites in the sacred land of Ujjain for generations, and he continues this tradition with precise Vedic methods.
priest.experience: He has been honored with the title of Acharya in Vedic rituals and for more than 25 years has been performing Vedic and tantric rituals to help remove various doshas and life obstacles. He also advises families on auspicious dates, personalized puja schedules, and spiritual healing with pure offerings.
priest.additional: He provides warm, personalized guidance so every ceremony is meaningful, spiritually uplifting, and aligned with your family’s needs.

services.title: For every puja and dosh nivaran need

items.title: Abhishek Ritual
items.description: Vedic abhishek for Lord Shiva and other deities with mantra chanting.
items.details: Sacred water abhishek is performed with traditional Vedic mantras to strengthen devotion and attract blessings.

items.title: Shani Dosh Nivaran
items.description: Special rituals to relieve the adverse effects of Shani, Sade-Sati, and Dhaiya.
items.details: This remedy ritual uses proven Vedic methods and mantras to reduce Saturn’s malefic influence and bring calm.

items.title: Navagraha Shanti
items.description: Balance and positive energy through rituals for all nine planets.
items.details: Navagraha Shanti rituals restore planetary balance and invite peace, success, and well-being into your life.

items.title: Mahamrityunjay Japa
items.description: Powerful chanting for protection from illness, fear, and untimely death.
items.details: This protective japa ceremony is focused on healing energy, health, and overcoming negative forces.

items.title: Navchandi & Shatachandi
items.description: Shakti sadhana and wish fulfillment through dedicated Durga recitation.
items.details: The Durga path invokes divine strength and protects your home, career, and family with sacred chanting.

items.title: Yagya & Havan
items.description: Environmental purification and planetary peace via sacred homa rituals.
items.details: A fire ceremony that cleanses energy, honors the gods, and helps create a peaceful atmosphere.

items.title: Shrimad Bhagwat Katha Ritual
items.description: A sacred storytelling ritual of the Shrimad Bhagwat Mahapurana to awaken devotion, knowledge, and detachment.
items.details: The divine narration brings spiritual awakening, peace, and deep insight through revered scripture.

items.title: Shiva Purana Katha Ritual
items.description: A ritual narration celebrating Lord Shiva's greatness, stories, and spiritual teachings.
items.details: The Shiva Purana path honors Lord Shiva with stories and rituals that inspire devotion and spiritual strength.

items.title: Complete Vedic Samskaras
items.description: Comprehensive Vedic rites from birth to marriage, housewarming, and other life rituals performed with full traditional procedure.
items.details: From child naming to wedding ceremonies, every samskara is completed with full Vedic discipline, purity, and care.
